about: Opt-in library skills, grouped into plugins of the local 'gigabrain' marketplace (library/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json). A skill listed here is written by bin/absorb-adapt.py to library/plugins/<plugin>/skills/<name>/ instead of library/skills/<name>/, so it loads only in projects that enable the plugin: claude plugin install <plugin>@gigabrain --scope local. Skills not listed stay global (symlinked into ~/.claude/skills by bin/install.sh). Plugin skills are invoked as /<plugin>:<skill>. Decided 2026-10-12 (roadmap phase 1).

knowledge.description: Backend stack knowledge with no measured lift over vanilla Claude (opt-in, no stack enables it): Postgres, Redis, NestJS, Node backend, migrations, REST API design, error handling. Retired from global 2026-10-14.

frontend.description: React and UI work: React patterns, performance and testing, Playwright E2E, accessibility, interface polish. Enabled by kit for the react stack.

python.description: Python work: idioms, pytest, FastAPI. Enabled by kit for the python and fastapi stacks.

go.description: Go work: idiomatic patterns and testing. Enabled by kit for the go stack.

deploy.description: Containers and deployment: Docker/Compose, CI/CD and rollout patterns, Kubernetes. Enabled by kit for the docker, k8s, aws and terraform stacks.

mcp.description: Building MCP servers. Enabled by kit for the mcp stack.

eng.description: Engineering practice skills that never fired in 35 days as globals (moved 2026-11-06): ADRs, contract-first, hexagonal architecture, legacy style rules, loop design check, production audit, search-first, secure coding, verification loop. Enabled by kit for the nest stack; elsewhere: claude plugin install eng@gigabrain --scope local.
